newsitem.title: USA: Iridium completes $750 million credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Iridium completes $750 million credit facility.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Iridium LLC said on Monday it completed a $750 million credit facility.

The Iridium venture, for which Motorola is the system inventor, project leader, system prime contractor and largest investor, is expected to be the first operational network for worldwide wireless telecommunications services via hand-held telephones and pagers, the company said.
The additional financing brings the total funds committed to the Iridium project to more than $2.65 billion.

The company said a longer term credit facility targeted for $2.6 billion is being structured and should be complete by year's end. This facility will replace the $750 million loan and is expected to complete the funding requirements for operation of Iridium LLC as well as the construction, launch and implementation of the system, the company said.
Robert Kinzie, chairman and chief executive of Iridium, said he expected the first satellites to be launched late this year, which he said was ahead of contract schedule.
The credit facility was co-arranged by Chase Securities Inc, a unit of Chase Manhattan Corp and the investment banking division of Barclays Bank PLC.
